battle.verdict: TubeBuddy Legend is the clear winner for serious creators, with its advanced SEO and testing features. However, the free version still helps new channels immensely.

narration.text: Legend's best feature costs twenty-five times more!
First, keyword research! TubeBuddy Free offers a basic explorer, but Legend goes all out. It gives you competitor analysis and AI-driven suggestions. Legend takes the round!

Next up, productivity features. Free offers bulk editing and basic best practices. But Legend brings A/B testing, demonetisation prevention, and an SEO studio to the table! No contest here, Legend wins again.
TubeBuddy Legend is the champion today, offering serious creators advanced SEO and powerful testing tools. Yet, the free version still helps new channels immensely. Which one would you pick?
